comments.author: philistine
comments.why: Tests found Beta's quality difference negligible.
comments.text: In tests done by Technology Connections, the difference was so small as to be inconsequential. It was technically better at its slowest speed, but you could barely perceive the difference and more importantly Sony disabled the feature in the vast majority of machines sold. People wanted more than 60 minutes out of one tape. They wanted 2 hours. [VIDEO]
